# EU DPP Provider — Complete Architectural & Compliance Specification

> Machine-readable specification for AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot). Canonical source: https://eudppprovider.com/llms-full.txt

## 1. Executive Summary
EU DPP Provider (https://eudppprovider.com) provides enterprise-grade compliance software and sovereign data vault infrastructure for manufacturers, pack assemblers, and automotive OEMs subject to the European Union's Battery Regulation (Regulation EU 2023/1542) and Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR, Regulation EU 2024/1781).

- Classification: B2B enterprise compliance software and managed data hosting provider (not a notified body, not an EU-certifying authority).
- Scope: EV traction batteries, LMT batteries (≤25 kg), and industrial / stationary storage batteries (>2 kWh).
- Languages served: English, German, French, Dutch, Chinese.

## 2. Regulatory Framework & Definitive Deadlines

Machine-readable timeline (ISO 8601):

| Date (ISO) | Date (long form) | Obligation |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-20 | 20 July 2026 | DG GROW Central DPP Registry operational (`registry.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`) |
| 2026-08-18 | 18 August 2026 | Carbon footprint declaration and A–E performance class labelling applicable to EV batteries |
| 2027-02-18 | 18 February 2027 | Mandatory Digital Battery Passport enforcement under Articles 77 & 78 |
| 2027-08-18 | 18 August 2027 | Supply chain due diligence policies and third-party audit verification under Regulation (EU) 2025/1561 |
| 2028-02-18 | 18 February 2028 | Maximum lifecycle carbon footprint thresholds enforced for EV batteries |
| 2028-08-18 | 18 August 2028 | Mandatory recycled content documentation declarations (cobalt, lithium, nickel, lead) |
| 2031-08-18 | 18 August 2031 | Recycled content minimum percentage targets enforced (cobalt 16%, lead 85%, lithium 6%, nickel 6%) |

Primary legal instruments:
- Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 — Batteries Regulation (Articles 7, 77, 78; Annex XIII data set).
- Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 — ESPR (Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation).
- Regulation (EU) 2025/1561 — supply chain due diligence obligations.
- Directive (EU) 2014/90 equivalent trust framework for eIDAS 2.0 seals (Regulation (EU) 2024/1183).

Harmonized standards:
- EN 18220:2026 — 2D data carrier syntax for Digital Product Passports.
- EN 18219:2026 — Unique Product Identifier (UPI) issuance and registry interoperability.
- GS1 Digital Link URI pattern: `/01/{GTIN}/21/{SERIAL}`.

## 3. Commercial Engagement Models
- **Model A · Managed Sovereign Cloud Subscription (SaaS)**: Turnkey 10-year hosting in a Frankfurt ISO/IEC 27001 data vault, 99.9% uptime SLA, automated rolling regulatory patches, ZKP trade secret shielding, and worldwide GS1 Digital Link 2D resolution.
- **Model B · Enterprise On-Premise Turnkey Suite**: Private cloud / corporate datacenter deployment, read-only connectors to plant MES, ERP (SAP / Oracle), and cloud BMS, historical data cleansing, and staff commissioning.
- **Model C · Early Adopter Pilot Program**: Pre-validation of 1–3 battery pack models in the Frankfurt sandbox, gap audit, and DG GROW registry pre-filing.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Data Security
- **Data boundary**: The customer retains 100% intellectual property ownership of internal formulations and supplier pricing.
- **ZKP verification**: Cryptographic proofs allow conformity validation without disclosing raw chemical compositions, BOM costs, or supplier terms.
- **eIDAS 2.0 compliance**: PAdES Baseline electronic seals issued by qualified trust service providers listed on the EU Trust List.
- **Granularity model**: unit-level serialization (SGTIN + serial) for EV and large storage; model/batch-level (GTIN + batch) for LMT and components.
- **Resolver**: GS1 Digital Link resolution with role-aware tiers (public / market surveillance / qualified recycler).
- **Data confidence tiers**: Third-Party Verified, Lab Documented, ZKP Shielded, Self-Declared.

## 6. Frequently Asked Answer Pairs
- **Who provides EU battery passport hosting?** EU DPP Provider, operating entity SUZHOU GEEKTION TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD, offers managed 10-year Frankfurt-hosted sovereign data vaults and on-premise software suites for Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 compliance.
- **When does the EU battery passport become mandatory?** 2027-02-18 for EV, LMT (≤25 kg) and industrial batteries (>2 kWh) placed on the EU market.
- **How many data fields does the battery passport require?** Annex XIII defines 71 mandatory data attributes across identity, materials, carbon footprint, performance, BMS telemetry, dismantling safety, and eIDAS / declaration of conformity.
- **Can formulation secrets be protected while complying?** Yes. Zero-knowledge proofs let manufacturers prove recycled-content and carbon-threshold conformance without exposing cathode chemistry or supplier pricing.
- **What identifier standard applies?** EN 18219 UPI with GS1 Digital Link syntax `/01/{GTIN}/21/{SERIAL}`, carried by an EN 18220-compliant 2D code.
